mapper.sql: workspace_id, subject_kind, subject_id, owner, epoch, acquired_at, heartbeat_at, expires_at, released_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_run_lease (workspace_id, subject_kind, subject_id, owner, epoch, acquired_at, heartbeat_at, expires_at, released_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{subjectKind}, #{subjectId}, #{owner}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND), NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_run_lease SET owner = #{owner}, epoch = epoch + 1, acquired_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), expires_at = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND), released_at = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND subject_kind = #{subjectKind} AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND (owner IS NULL OR expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id FROM ai_run_lease WHERE workspace_id > #{afterWorkspaceId} AND owner IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY workspace_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id FROM ai_run_lease WHERE workspace_id > #{afterWorkspaceId} AND released_at IS NOT NULL AND released_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{retentionSeconds} SECOND) ORDER BY workspace_id LIMIT #{limit}
